summary: Extend canary-based intervention validation from 2 architectures (Pythia-410M, Pythia-1.4B) to 5 by adding GPT-2-medium, OPT-1.3B, and Qwen2.5-0.8B. Each architecture needs predictive (canary-based) and reactive (baseline) intervention runs. No-intervention baselines already exist for GPT-2-medium and OPT-1.3B.
